name: publicdebt
description: Open-data platform for exploring public debt across the European Union.

scripts.validate:all: npm run validate && npm run validate:countries
scripts.fetch: npm run fetch:eurostat && npm run fetch:mfcr && npm run fetch:forecast && npm run fetch:population
scripts.transform: npm run transform:eurostat && npm run transform:mfcr && npm run transform:forecast && npm run transform:population && npm run transform:eu && npm run transform:overview
scripts.update: npm run fetch && npm run transform && npm run validate:all
scripts.release: npm run update && npm run build && npm run validate:build && npm run validate:links
scripts.release:stage: npm run update && npm run build:stage && npm run validate:build:stage && npm run validate:links
